events.name: Jurassic Quest | Charleston Coliseum | Charleston, WV 2026
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure Is Here!  

Jurassic Quest is bigger than ever, bringing together dinosaurs, prehistoric sea creatures, and Ice Age giants in one unforgettable experience.  

🦕 Jurassic Quest – Walk among life-sized, moving dinosaurs including the mighty T. rex, towering Apatosaurus, and massive Spinosaurus. Dig for fossils, meet adorable baby dinos, and ride your favorite prehistoric giants.  
🌊 Ancient Oceans – Dive beneath the surface and come face-to-face with incredible creatures that ruled the seas millions of years ago, including our jaw-dropping 53-foot Megalodon.
❄️ Frozen Frontier – Step into the Ice Age and encounter legendary creatures like the Woolly Mammoth and Saber-Toothed Cat as you explore a world frozen in time.

Plus enjoy interactive exhibits, hands-on activities, inflatables, rides, photo opportunities, and prehistoric fun for the whole family.

🎟️ One ticket gets you access to all three incredible experiences. Don't miss North America's largest prehistoric adventure — get your tickets before they go extinct! 🦖✨

venues.name: Charleston Coliseum

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday - Friday: 10AM - 5PM Saturday - Sunday: Hours vary depending on events and onsales.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Customers can pick up their tickets on the day of the show at the Will Call Window. Customers must have actual credit card, a picture ID, and their confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available through the Civic Center. Fees start at $3.00.

generalInfo.generalRule: All Coliseum access elevators provide access to the 100-level concourse only. The 200-level seating is only accessible by steps. Cameras and recording devices are not permitted.
generalInfo.childRule: Children under 2 are admitted free, but must sit on parents lap. Ages 2 and up must have a ticket. For family shows this age limit may change - please refer to the information posted with the show.

Daniel In The Lions' Den
events.info: Daniel in the Lions' Den and Esther: The Bravest Queen brings two timeless stories together in one unforgettable live musical adventure. Watch Esther risk everything to save her people, then journey to ancient Babylon as Daniel courageously faces the lions? den. With soaring original music, dazzling design, humor, and heart, this family-friendly production from The Originals Live is an inspiring theatrical experience for audiences of all ages. Bring the whole family and experience the unforgettable stories of two of history's bravest heroes! Children under 2 years old do not require a ticket to sit on a parent's lap, but all other customers do.
